def dec(g, klo, khi, thr=0.0, mode='rot'):
    x=xi.clone(); sc=[]
    fired=torch.zeros(N,dtype=torch.bool)
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((N,),1-k/20)
        v,a=net.velocity(x,t,c,("out_act",),count=False)
        s=a['out_act']@w+b; sc.append(s)
        if g!=0 and klo<=k<khi:
            f=s>thr; fired|=f
            if mode=='rot': d=torch.stack([-x[:,1], x[:,0]],1)*(-g)  # action move direction clockwise
            else: d=torch.tensor(mode).float().expand(N,2)*g
            v=v+torch.where(f[:,None], -d, torch.zeros_like(d))
        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy(), torch.stack(sc).numpy(), fired.numpy()
